title: Snake: One Step
story: A snake is a list of (x, y) cells, head first. Each step the head moves and the tail follows, unless the snake just ate and grows.
goal: Write step(snake, direction, grow=False): return the new snake. MOVES gives the change for N, S, E and W. y grows downward.
hints: The new head is the old head plus the move. What happens to the last cell?
snake[:-1] is the snake without its tail. Put the new head in front.
socratic: Which end of the list is the head?
What changes when grow is True?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Snake: One Step”?
